P.name: Cursed Touch
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Amumu's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}<!--on-hit? on-attack? on-damage?--> and ''{{ai|Curse of the Sad Mummy|Amumu}}'' are empowered to mark enemies with ''Curse'' for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and ''{{ais|Despair|Amumu}}'' per-tick damage.
P.description2: ''Cursed'' targets receive {{sti|{{as|10% '''bonus''' true damage}}}} from all incoming {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} {{as|magic damage}}.

Q.name: Bandage Toss
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Amumu''' throws a bandage in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second and {{tip|dash|pulling}} him to them, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.
Q.description2: '''Amumu''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Bandage Toss'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
Q.description3: ''{{ai|Despair|Amumu}} can be cast during the dash.''

W.name: Despair
W.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Amumu''' cries a continuous pool of tears, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to nearby enemies.
W.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|5 {{as|(+ {{ap|0.5 to 1}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description2: ''Despair'' is toggled off automatically if '''Amumu''' becomes unable to pay its {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.

E.name: Tantrum
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Amumu''' reduces every instance of {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} {{as|physical damage}} taken, capped at 50% of the damage instance.
E.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Reduction|{{ap|5 to 13}} {{as|(+ 3% '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 3% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}}}}
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Amumu''' releases his anger, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
E.description3: ''Tantrum's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.75}} seconds whenever '''Amumu''' is hit by a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}}.

R.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Amumu''' entangles nearby enemies in bandages, dealing {{as|magic damage}} as well as {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
